text.text_excerpt: Yes, yes & yes! Justine was an amazing experience. The service was great and all the staff (I think our server's name was Christopher) that helped us along the way were truly a blessing. We were celebrating two birthdays so we did the whole shebang, cocktail selections were nice though lacking one made with vodka - most were gin/bourbon-based. They do have a full bar though. Long list of wines, but a couple extra options for wines by the glass would have been nice. For food, I have been wanting to try the French Onion Soup for so long and it definitely lived up to the hype. Hands down the best French Onion Soup I have EVER had. My other favorite was the Mac au Fromage made with gruyere - ...

I think Justine is a great spot to go for a girls night out. The ambiance inside is beautiful, they did a great job curating it so that it makes you feel special and want to linger a while. When we were they they also had a cabaret dancer dressed as Marie Antoinette going around the restaurant. We ordered a few different menu items and shared them all. Overall the food was good, but nothing special that my mouth would water while describing it to you. Our fav thing out of the 5 things we ordered was the moroccan spiced short rib. The service was attentive, we were talked to by a number of important looking people who didn't seem in a rush, which again made us feel swanky. I would definite...

This was my first meal in New Orleans and it set the bar pretty high. I love the vibe here, it is fancy yet casual, classic yet modern. The service was good and they had a beautiful showgirl style dancer. My friends and I started with a round of delicious martinis to cheers to our upcoming week in town. I had the Croque Monsieur with frites. It was wonderful and I probably ate way too much of it. It was huge but since it was soooo good it was hard for me to stop eating it. I also tried a spoonful of my friends onion soup. I am not usually a big fan but thought it was really tasty. All of my friends enjoyed their dinners as well so I would recommend Justine to anyone in search of a good meal.
